blocks.content:
The Watchers page is under **AI** in the main menu. Create a watcher by describing the service, system, or failure mode to monitor. Keep the scope narrow: one service, namespace, cluster, or failure mode. Include context Assistant can't infer from telemetry, for example whether short error spikes during deploys are expected.

This path uses **Set up manually** so you fill the form yourself. If you have Grafana Assistant, **Create with Assistant** is another way to start a watcher. It opens a conversation instead of this form.
To open the create form, complete the following steps:

blocks.hint: If the page isn't available, confirm Assistant is enabled and that you have Watchers read permission. Watchers isn't available in self-managed Grafana. In the main menu, **Watchers** is under **AI**.

blocks.content: Click **New watcher**, then click **Set up manually**.
blocks.hint: You need `grafana-assistant-app.watcher-agents:create` to create a watcher. **Create with Assistant** starts a conversation instead of the form.

blocks.content: You're on the **New watcher** form. Fill it in next. Don't click **Calibrate** yet.
To fill the form, complete the following steps:

blocks.title: Set intent, data sources, and cadence

blocks.content:
In **Name**, enter a name that's easy to recognize later.

**Checkout health** is filled in for you.
blocks.tooltip: You'll look this name up later in the Watchers list.

blocks.targetvalue: Watch my checkout service. During rollout some errors are expected and this is acceptable, but it should always recover fairly quickly.
blocks.content:
In **Give the watcher context**, describe what to monitor.

Include expected rollout behavior, known noise, and acceptable tolerances.
blocks.tooltip: Tell the watcher what it can't infer from telemetry alone.

blocks.content: In **Datasources**, pick at least one Prometheus, Loki, or BigQuery data source that you can query.
blocks.hint: **Calibrate** stays disabled until you select a data source.

blocks.content:
Leave **Repeats** at **Every 15 minutes** unless you need a longer interval.

The interval must be between 15 minutes and 3 hours.
blocks.hint: Skip if you already changed the interval.

blocks.content:
Leave **Sensitivity** at **Balanced**.

Change it only if you know the watcher should be more or less sensitive.
blocks.hint: Skip if you already changed sensitivity.

blocks.content:
Your watcher has a name, context, data sources, cadence, and sensitivity. Leave **Post to Slack**, **Send to a webhook**, and **Launch on a critical assessment** off for this intro.

Don't click **Calibrate** yet. You'll do that in the next milestone.
